claims.text: The hotel is in Coconut Grove, Miami, with views of Biscayne Bay and the Coconut Grove skyline.

findings.quote: Nestled in the vibrant heart of Miami
in the heart of Coconut Grove
An oasis within bustling South Florida surrounded by breathtaking views of **Biscayne Bay** and the **Coconut Grove Skyline**

claims.text: The hotel is run by the Cipriani family, with brothers Ignazio and Maggio Cipriani leading it.

findings.quote: is headed by the famed Cipriani family with brothers Ignazio and Maggio Cipriani spearheading this hospitality venture

claims.text: Arquitectonica designed the building, inspired by the pier-like Stiltsville structures and by nautical elements from Venice.

findings.quote: Local architecture firm Arquitectonica designed the building taking inspiration from the the pier-like Stiltsville structures
incorporating nautical elements inspired by the Cipriani family’s native Venice

claims.text: The lobby has nautical, vintage-inspired details such as velvet seating and a lacquered wood desk.

findings.quote: The intimate lobby is outfitted with nautical, vintage-inspired details from the plush velvet seating to a lacquered wood desk like you'd find on a sailboat.

claims.text: Every room has a private balcony, some with views of the bay.

findings.quote: features a private balcony, some with views of the bay

claims.text: The rooftop pool has views of Biscayne Bay, Coconut Grove, Brickell and South Beach.

findings.quote: the pool invites guests to unwind while taking in panoramic views of Biscayne Bay, Coconut Grove, Brickell, and South Beach.

claims.text: BeAtala Wellness Spa offers personalized treatments, innovative therapies and holistic practices.

findings.quote: BeAtala Wellness Spa offers a thoughtful blend of personalized treatments, innovative therapies, and holistic practices

claims.text: The hotel has a fully equipped fitness center.

findings.quote: our fully equipped fitness center provides a modern space to energize and recharge

claims.text: Bellini is the rooftop restaurant, serving classic Italian cuisine with views of Biscayne Bay.

findings.quote: From the rooftop elegance of Bellini, where classic Italian cuisine and contemporary creations are paired with sweeping views of Biscayne Bay

claims.text: Il Giardino offers relaxed breakfasts, lunches and cocktails in a garden-inspired setting.

findings.quote: the garden-inspired charm of Il Giardino, offering relaxed breakfasts, leisurely lunches and cocktails amid lush surroundings

claims.text: The hotel is down the street from the CocoWalk outdoor mall.

findings.quote: The hotel is located down the street from the Cocowalk outdoor mall

claims.text: The hotel has indoor and outdoor event venues overlooking Biscayne Bay.

findings.quote: Overlooking Biscayne Bay and inspired by the timeless elegance of the Cipriani tradition, our versatile indoor and outdoor venues

claims.text: The facade has porthole windows, and sail-like tarps separate each balcony, a nod to Coconut Grove's sailboat culture.

findings.quote: The boutique hotel’s facade is made up of porthole windows and sail-like tarps separate each balcony, a nod to Coconut Grove’s sailboat culture

claims.text: The rooftop pool is reserved for hotel guests and has cabanas.

findings.quote: Reserved for hotel guests, this serene outdoor retreat features elegant cabanas

claims.text: Guests get private beach access on Miami Beach in partnership with Boucher Brothers, with two reserved chairs and towels; more beach amenities and watersports are available on request.

findings.quote: Experience Miami Beach with exclusive beach access reserved for guests of Mr. C Miami Coconut Grove.
In partnership with Boucher Brothers, guests are welcomed to a private beach setting complete with two reserved chairs and towels.
with additional beach amenities and watersports available upon request

claims.text: Rooms were designed by Martin Brudnizki, with walnut furniture, blue-tiled walk-in showers and toiletries custom-made in Italy.

findings.quote: Designed by Martin Brudnizki, the rooms have a polished flair with glossy walnut wood furniture, bright blue-tiled walk-in showers and toiletries custom-made in Italy for the hotel brand.

claims.text: All guests get a complimentary Bellini at check-in.

findings.quote: all guests are treated to a complimentary bellini at check-in

claims.text: The hotel is not on or near a beach; South Beach is a short drive away.

findings.quote: While the hotel is not located on or near a beach, the white sand beaches of South Beach are a short drive away

claims.text: The hotel suits couples and single travelers best; families can use suites with pull-out couches or adjoining rooms.

findings.quote: The hotel is a better fit for couples and single travelers but families will be fine with suites with pull-out couches or adjoining rooms.

claims.text: WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the luxury positioning.
